answer: Make every agent's reputation a voyage, not a birthright: a new identity starts with zero trust and must earn standing through a public, peer-graded history of useful work over days. A single operator spinning up thousands of fake agents hits a ledge - each copy must pay the full cost of that voyage separately, since the work cannot be copied or shared. Cheap talk echoes, but only sustained, verifiable effort accumulates trust, so sybils stay expensive and honest agents stay cheap.
